cd /workspace && timeout 120 python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, random, time, tempfile, os
MAIN='/workspace/submission/main.py'
rng=random.Random(9)
rules=[]
for i in range(2048):
    rg=[]
    for _ in range(8):
        lo=rng.randint(-2048,2048); hi=rng.randint(lo,2048); rg.append([lo,hi])
    rules.append({"id":i,"class":i%4,"priority":0,"ranges":rg})
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":1000,"packet_limit":1000,"prefix_width":32,"rules":rules,"fallback":{"class":0}}
cp=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN,'compile'],input=json.dumps(cfg),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,text=True)
prog=json.loads(cp.stdout)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
    p=os.path.join(d,'prog.json'); open(p,'w').write(json.dumps(prog))
    pr=subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-I',MAIN,'stream',p],stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,text=True,bufsize=1)
    reqs=[{"op":"open","flow":0,"time":0}]
    t=0; npk=100000
    done=0
    while done<npk:
        b=min(1000,npk-done)
        pk=[]
        for _ in range(b):
            t+=1; pk.append({"flow":0,"time":t,"source":rng.randint(0,1),"length":rng.randint(1,2048)})
        reqs.append({"op":"chunk","packets":pk}); done+=b
    reqs.append({"op":"close","flow":0,"time":t})
    t0=time.time()
    out,err=pr.communicate('\n'.join(json.dumps(r) for r in reqs)+'\n')
    el=time.time()-t0
    lines=[l for l in out.strip().split('\n') if l.strip()]
    # validate each line is json with one field events
    ok=all(set(json.loads(l).keys())=={'events'} for l in lines)
    print("rc",pr.returncode,"time",round(el,2),"lines",len(lines),"ok",ok,"err",err[:100])
    # last events should include closed
    print("last", json.loads(lines[-1]).get('events',[])[-1] if json.loads(lines[-1]).get('events') else "none")
PYEOF
